description: THE COMPLAINT DESK reads: no filed complaint, no public exposure — MAD does not carry a grievance nobody signed. With no filingId, lists every complaint filed at the desk, newest first, each with its status. With a filingId (e.g. CMP-0001), returns that filing in full with its status/grade history. Filings are public to claimant AND respondent alike. A filing prints UNGRADED / UNVERIFIED until MAD grades it — a filing is an allegation in the open, not a verdict. To file: POST /v1/complaints on the REST door (free; claimant {name required}, respondent {name required}, claim required, category payable | broken_promise | number_mismatch | other, optional amount/currency/evidence).

filingId.description: Optional: one filing id, e.g. CMP-0001; omit to list all filings
